## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; confirmation: mixed sector returns (Utilities, Energy, Tech, Financials positive vs 7 sectors negative) and major divergence across large caps (≥3 megacaps showing 1W ≠ 1M). Leadership concentration is Narrow (Top 5: 4/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: VLO (1W: +7.45% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +10.65%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities showing strength with VST (1W: +9.43% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: CHTR (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -11.38% | 1M: -18.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +9.43% | 1M: +5.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); style mixed / no clear leadership given limited breadth.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -7.45% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -8.25% | 1M: +2.88%) CORRECTION (TREND EXHAUSTION), CHTR (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -12.66%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -6.13%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -9.32% | 1M: -18.29%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology and parts of Healthcare/Comm.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.38% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND. Note MA/V/V/ AAPL/ JNJ show TREND EXHAUSTION (1W down, 1M up) — major divergence, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leadership via chip and platform names; INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND while ADBE (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND and PANW (1W: -7.45% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 4/11 sectors positive overall; internal rotation in Tech given dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials flat-to-mixed: JPM (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: +1.87%) TREND EXHAUSTION, MA (1W: -2.34% | 1M: +0.77%) TREND EXHAUSTION. Sector is marginally positive on the week but lacks broad confirmation; monitor for follow-through.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare pressured: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND. News divergence: high bullish headlines for ABT/MDT/UNH but large negative reads on NVS and SYK — sector at risk until sentiment aligns with price.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain neutral posture; favor selective exposure to confirmed winners (INTC, AMD, META) while reducing exposure to laggards in Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary. Given narrow leadership and major divergence, emphasize tactical sizing and monitor trend breaks.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +14.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.45% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVS (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (leaders concentrated in semiconductors and select platforms; sector 1W: +1.03%), Energy (1W: +1.65%) showing strong 1M outperformance. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -4.04%) and Communication (1W: -3.34%) remain under pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch INTC for sustainment of weekly momentum (continued weekly gains > +10% would confirm rotation into semiconductors). Monitor META keeping above recent 1W pivot (continued weekly strength confirms leadership). NVDA hold above recent 1M pivot (+2.8% 1W) as test for broad Tech follow-through. NVS further weekly weakness / failure to stabilize would deepen Healthcare risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (+55): (1W: -10.69% | 1M: -5.67%) BELOW TREND — bullish headlines but price falling, divergence indicates distribution. UNH (+50): (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -3.84%) BELOW TREND — positive news yet price not confirming, monitor for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVS (-75): (1W: -14.74% | 1M: -12.32%) BELOW TREND — very bearish news and price confirming. QCOM (-45): (1W: +6.45% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines but price rising, divergence to watch. MSFT (-40): (1W: -1.87% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirming modest price weakness. SYK (-45): (1W: -13.24% | 1M: -20.36%) BELOW TREND — bearish news and price confirming.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and leadership Narrow (Top 5: 4/5 Technology). INTC (1W: +19.41% | 1M: +8.94%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +9.88%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +7.45% | 1M: +23.50%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among megacaps (multiple TREND EXHAUSTION cases) and conflicting sentiment in Healthcare (e.g., NVS -75 news confirming price weakness; AMGN bullish headlines but price falling) — monitor for trend confirmation.
